style: Cute pseudo-3D, soft rounded plush/clay form, studio light upper left, natural recognizable animal colors, kind expressive eyes. Full body, three-quarter front view, centered with clear margins, truly transparent background. No text, clothes, props, other animals or scene.

stagePrompts.baby: BABY infant proportions: oversized head, tiny round body, short limbs, round cheeks, no mature antlers. Visibly the youngest stage.
stagePrompts.young: YOUNG adolescent proportions: medium sized body, playful energetic pose, longer limbs and more developed wings or tail than an infant, head moderately large. Visibly growing, not a tiny baby.
stagePrompts.adult: ADULT fully grown proportions: fuller larger body, complete mature markings, elegant fully developed wings, fins or tail, confident calm pose. Still very cute with expressive large eyes but head-to-body ratio smaller than an infant.
